days.title: Algeciras Coastal Sights
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: ensenada de Getares
stops.detail: El Estrecho Natural Park is located at the southern tip of the Iberian Peninsula and protects the maritime-terrestrial space of the coastline from the Getares inlet (Algeciras) to the Cape of Gracia (Tarifa).

stops.name: punta de San García
stops.detail: The southern land limit of the park goes from the point of Gracia in the municipality of Tarifa to the point of San García in the municipality of Algeciras.

stops.name: Cala Arenas
stops.detail: Submarine reserve zones are the stretches of coast located in front of the beaches of Bolonia and Los Lances or the coast in front of San García point, Cala Arenas, Cabrita island, or Las Palomas island.

days.title: Bolonia and Western Ranges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: isla de Las Palomas
stops.detail: The marine area of the park includes one nautical mile measured from the perpendicular line of the coast in the entire section from Gracia point to San García point, except for the coastal front of the city of Tarifa to the east of Las Palomas island, which is maintained as a reserve zone for the Port Authority of the Bay of Algeciras for future expansions of the port of Tarifa.

stops.name: sierra de la Plata
stops.detail: The western zone has its first section, corresponding to Los Lances beach, delimited by the N-340, while its western end takes the summit of San Bartolomé hill and almost the entirety of the Plata mountain range as its limit.
